title: Honesty Is Beautiful
summary: Rafi breaks Mother's favourite vase and learns that honesty brings peace of mind. (Bukhari and Muslim, on honesty)
moral: Be honest even when you have done wrong. Tell the truth, apologise, and take responsibility to make it right.
pages: Mother went to the market and said, 'Rafi, look after the house, and do not run around inside.' But Rafi was busy playing aeroplanes, running here and there with his arms stretched out.
Crash! Rafi's hand bumped Mother's favourite blue vase. It fell and shattered into pieces. Rafi stood frozen, eyes wide.
Rafi's heart pounded. 'What if Mother gets angry? I had better keep quiet and pretend I do not know.' But his heart was restless and uneasy.

Rafi remembered the words of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وسلم, 'You must be truthful, for truthfulness leads to goodness, and goodness leads to Paradise.' (Bukhari and Muslim). Rafi took a deep breath and decided to tell the truth.
When Mother came home, Rafi came to her and said softly, 'Mother, forgive me. I was running inside and I broke your vase.' Mother was startled, looked at the pieces, then looked at Rafi.

Mother smiled and hugged Rafi. 'I am sad the vase broke, but I am proud that you were honest. Be careful next time, all right?' Rafi helped Mother clean up the pieces carefully, promising not to run inside the house.
Rafi's heart felt relieved and light. He learned that telling the truth brings calm, and that apologising makes us children loved by Allah and by Mother. The end.
